LED-based OWPT technologies have potential as viable energy sources for several software and hardware implementations, especially those involving the Internet of Things. The lack of electromagnetic interference noise, increased directionality, looser safety restrictions, and extended communication ranges are all positives. In this article, we offer better LED-OWPT devices that rely on collimation method as a means of improving the system's dimensions as well as its output. With a single LED arrangement, the system size may be reduced by 46% while still maintaining its excellent transmission efficiency. The LED array system has had its dimensions reduced by 56%, while simultaneously seeing a 40% increase in its output. During the course of the experiment, a transmission distance of one meter was used to obtain a high power production of 532 mW. In addition, the LED-array OWPT system clarifies the impact of misalignment among the LED and the lens, as well as the possibility for long -distance transmission.

articleTitle: Realization Criteria of Terminal Radiation Disposition on Circular Aperture Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A radiation pattern in three dimensions is observed for proper evaluation of the Terminal Radiation Disposition (TRD) of circular aperture antenna. The clarity on stroboscopic symmetry, well-defined for larger number of points from a database, allows for rigorous practical designs to be realized. Evaluation is computationally performed with Scilab using simple mathematical manipulations for using predefined Bessel functions in integration. All the results look similar unless a particular value is sought after.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: When patients are aware of their risk for developing Alzheimer's disease (AD), they are better able to take preventative steps before permanent brain damage occurs, making an accurate diagnosis of AD during inpatient treatment crucial. Among those aged 65 and up, Alzheimer's is so far the most popular form of dementia. There's a significant amount of interest in making use of machine learning to enhance the diagnosis of metabolic illnesses popularly known as Alzheimer's and diabetes. The rates at which they occur are increasing alarmingly every year. Alzheimer's causes brain changes due to neurodegenerative processes. Conditions impairing cognitive abilities are on the rise, burdening patients' loved ones and the healthcare system. The social, economic, and monetary sectors will all feel the effects of these shifts profoundly. Diagnosing Alzheimer's disease in its early stages is challenging. Studies have indicated that if Alzheimer's disease is treated early on, it has a better chance of being cured and has fewer side effects. Parameters used to forecast the onset of Alzheimer's disease can be optimized using a variety of classifiers, including Decision Trees, Support Vector Machines, Gradient Boosting, Random Forests, and Voting classifiers. Recently, deep learning (DL) has seen widespread use in the field of Alzheimer's disease early detection. After exploring how DL can help in the early identification of AD and presenting a brief literature review on the topic.

articleTitle: Comparison of Schmitt Trigger Oscillators using logic gates in 45nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Oscillators are the backbone of communication system. Usually frequency of oscillations drift with temperature, process etc. In this paper, an inverting Schmitt trigger based Oscillators are designed and simulated, output is observed on Cadence virtuoso tool in gpdk045 library (45nm technology). Performance parameters such as output noise, delay, power are analyzed. Oscillator frequencies are observed at different temperatures. EX-OR gate based Oscillator using inverting Schmitt trigger found to have constant frequency with varying temperature whereas NAND gate based oscillator using Schmitt trigger found to have better noise and power performance.

articleTitle: Classification of Blood Cell Data using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Machine Learning is an established branch of artificial intelligence that comprises of algorithms and mathematical relationships and is rapidly being used to clinical research. Machine Learning enables computers to be programmed without explicit information and to learn from it. The outcomes of using these technologies in medical data processing have been amazing, with great effectiveness in detecting illnesses. According to studies, Machine Learning techniques significantly improve complex medical decision-making processes in medical image processing by extracting and then evaluating the features of these pictures. An urgent demand for more sophisticated data analysis approaches has arisen as the number of medical diagnosis tools rose and a significant amount of high-quality data was produced. Traditional methodologies are incapable of examining such vast amounts of data. One of the critical diseases, Leukemia can be found in the blood cell data image of patients by applying machine learning algorithms. Here in this paper, the blood cell images available in the open literature are analyzed using the different algorithm networks for the refinement of images to identify the diseases like leukemia.

articleTitle: Active and reactive power regulation utilising an ANN controller for a PV Fed Trans Quasi-Z Source Network with a Multilevel Grid-Tied System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: New Z-source inverter and quasi Z-source inverter topologies and their variations suitable for solar photovoltaic power systems are designed and developed in this study, with verification by simulation and experimental validation. In order to create topologies of Z-source inverters that are well-suited for a wide range of uses, researchers have analysed current Z-source inverter designs in depth. In order to get the performance characteristics of solar photovoltaic systems, which are used in the design of the impedance network of Z-source inverters, modelling, simulation, and experimental verification of solar photovoltaic systems are performed. With the help of simulation and appropriate Matlab software, the optimal PV array configuration for use in the proposed Z-source inverter topologies is determined by analysing the performance of photovoltaic (PV) modules connected in a variety of array configurations under normal/partial shaded conditions.

articleTitle: Implementation of Realtime design of crowd Enumeration via tracking using AI system
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Crowd enumeration can help to evaluate and count the number of visitors to a place. There are many reasons that spana wide range of applications, from security considerations, optimization of operations to efficiency in profitability. In the paper, we propose to develop a prototype for implementing a high frame rate, low processing environment, high performance, and highly efficient real-time crowd enumeration system. The latest method for object detection is deep learning. When it comes to deep learning or machine learning, performance and computation are the key parameters. In our model, there is a provision to schedule the model for the required amount of time. In our work, we are using mobilenet SSD as an object detector to detect humans. It is a preprocessed, highly efficient, and light weight model which can run on low power device like jetson nano and is cost-efficient unlike others. The advantage of our model is if there is overcrowding in a specified location with known capacity, alarm is enabled.

articleTitle: Histopathological Cancer Detection with Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Cancer is one of the most dreaded diseases faced by mankind today, largely because of the huge medical cost & high mortality rate. It is a serious and potentially life-threatening medical condition that can affect different parts of the body. The treatment and severity of any sort of cancer is determined by its accurate diagnosis for an affected person. There were approx. 10 million deaths recorded in the year 2020 due to cancer. Also, the study of histopathological cancer using modern technologies such as machine learning and deep neural networks became an area of interest. Research on histopathological cancer is quite popular among the researchers using different machine learning techniques such as Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Self-supervised Learning (SSL), Feed-forward Neural Network (FNN), etc. These techniques are very prominent in detecting cancer at its early stages. Hence the survival rate of patients can be increased as the spreading of malignant cells can be reduced, upon detection. The research conducted on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) shows the highest accuracy in classifying the cancer cells & non-cancer cells. The accuracy recorded was between 93%-96%. The paper aims to explore the use of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) as a potential model in detection of histopathological cancer with its accuracy and its ability to detect at the early stage for an affected person.

articleTitle: Detection of Human Brain Tumors Using an UWB Patch Antenna at 28GHz
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: It is proposed to design and utilize a strip line inset fed Ultra-Wide Band (UWB) patch antenna having a bandwidth of 7GHz resonating from 23GHz to 30GHz in order to identify the existence of tumor inside a human brain. A six layered healthy brain model has been designed and a 5mm radius tumor is positioned inside the brain model. A comparative analysis of radiation properties of patch antenna for a normal healthy and a tumor induced brain model has been done. The comparative analysis of performance metrics of the proposed patch antenna viz. bandwidth, directivity, gain, return loss, voltage standing wave ratio and electric field intensity for both the brain models has been done. According to the results, a brain model with a tumor has a greater SAR than a brain model with a healthy brain. Based on the obtained results, the proposed patch antenna could potentially be utilized for detection of tumor in human brain.

Author Keywords: detection of tumor in the Brain

articleTitle: Link Prediction in Social Networks using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Prediction in social networks is an intriguing topic which has recently received a lot of attention. Given a snapshot of a dynamic social network, represented as a directed graph of nodes and edges (where nodes represent users and edges represent followers), the problem can be phrased as follows: - followed relations) Can we forecast which new relationships (links) will emerge in the near future? Such predictions can be used to recommend “friend suggestions” on Facebook, “fresh subjects” on Twitter, “interesting movies” and other tailored Netflix recommendations, among other things. The link prediction problem was proposed in this research for a dataset acquired from Twitch, an online video streaming platform.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Classification using Le-Net Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Roadside traffic signs are crucial to our safety while we are travelling. Similar to human drivers, classification of traffic signs is a crucial component in self-driving car applications. Self-driving cars must use camera data to make judgments based on what they observe. Self-driving cars must be able to recognize things and classify traffic signs in order for us to know when they cease yielding and if they will go at a speed of 30 or 50 kilometers per hour. To categorize traffic signs, utilize the traffic sign classification system. so that they can be informed and warned in advance to prevent rule violations. The suggested approach substantially addresses certain drawbacks of the current classification systems, such as inaccurate predictions, hardware cost, and maintenance. The suggested method uses LE-NET architecture to provide a categorization of traffic signs. This will enable autonomous vehicles to decide depending on what they perceive.

articleTitle: Assessing the Suitability of Meta-analysis for Biomarker Identification in Coronary Artery Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Coronary artery disease, a heritable cardiovascular disorder is the leading cause of mortality worldwide. Despite substantial progress in understanding its pathophysiology and treatment strategies, the genetic basis of this disease remain poorly understood. High-throughput experiments such as genome-wide association studies and microarray gene expression profiling offer valuable information to uncover disease targets and underlying mechanisms. Meta-analysis is a widely used statistical approach that synthesizes evidences across multiple studies that are typically conducted under diverse conditions. Although meta-analysis has been previously used in omic data mining, its suitability to identify target gene or biomarker for coronary artery disease remains unexplored. Specifically, identifying differentially expressed genes using meta-analysis is often complicated by several factors such as the differences in microarray technique, study focus, data quality, gene nomenclature, species, intervention, and the statistical models used for analysis. Therefore, in this work, we combined meta-analysis of microarray data with various quality control tools, gene ontology and pathways enrichment analysis to identify potential differentially expressed genes of coronary artery disease. Gene expression data from four different studies were analyzed individually and using meta-analysis of combined data, which results in five differentially expressed genes that are thought to involve in coronary artery disease. It was demonstrated that data heterogeneity and selection of statistical measures play a key role in meta-analysis based biomarker identification in systems biology.

articleTitle: The Dashboard Infrastructure of Electric Vehicles with IoT and Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The development of contactless sharing is a significant milestone that demonstrates the technology's superiority. This project demonstrates how IoT Sensor nodes powered by a battery can be powered wirelessly. As a result, the project necessitates replacing the battery with a more effective wireless power system. This idea of Internet of Things technology serves as the project's foundation, storing and continuously monitoring data from massive IoT sensors in a particular field [12]. It is suggested that this idea be applied to wireless power technology. A transmitter device that is powered by electric power from the source and creates a time-varying electromagnetic field transmits power across a medium to a receiver device that takes power from the field and supplies it to an electrical load in this wireless power transmission system. The average end-to-end transmission time is used to calculate both the system's overall efficiency and its energy efficiency. The maximum power transfer between the transmitting coil and the receiving coil was achieved at 5.8 cm, which is consistent with the findings of the experiments [23]. With a 15-second delay, the WPT secondary voltage and current values are uploaded to the open-access Thingspeak cloud for monitoring.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Low Power UWB Transmitter Using Second Derivative Gaussian Pulse
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A low-power ultra-wideband (UWB) transmitter is proposed with the basic building blocks having an oscillator, modulator, and pulse generator using 90-nm CMOS technology in Cadence Virtuoso using a smaller number of transistors and passive elements. Frequency is generated using a ring oscillator with a common-gate switching nMOS to vary the delay. Different frequency is generated by varying the control voltage from 1V to 5V generating a 5.6 GHz to 7.0 GHz carrier wave. Moreover, a different range of frequency generation is also proposed with different capacitor values with the ring oscillator. BPSK modulation technique is implemented for its higher efficiency over other techniques. A very compact high-frequency BPSK design is proposed for the modulation circuit. Then, a Gaussian second-order pulse is generated with a 140ps pulse width. Gaussian pulse with varying widths can also be generated using the proposed model. The maximum sizing used for the transistors does not exceed 2 µm. The simulation results show the better performance of the transmitter in case of noise, efficiency, and BER over the other existing UWB transmitters.

articleTitle: An Approach to Disambiguate the Innate Sense of a Message with the Help of Emoji
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This project aims to understand the tonality of a text using emoticons as the predictor. The emoticons have transpired to be an increasingly significant and standardized part of modern textual inputs. The combination of visual and textual content in the same message builds a compact form of communication, sometimes which becomes tough to portray by the words only. Emoticon prediction and word-emoticon embedding could be used for any kind of Sentiment Analysis based works like Opinion Mining, User Profiling etc. This work focuses on identifying the tone of emotion behind a body of text which is used to analyze the sentiment of a user according to h(is)er comments or messages in online media. This experiment is carried out on the comments collected from some Twitter handles, Facebook walls and Whatsapp conversations. During the experiment, it is observed that in a few cases the senses of different comments are not possible to retrieve only from the words, but the texts which are combined with some emoticons are evaluated correctly. Challenges faced in this work are explained at the end of this report.

articleTitle: Music Note Recognition Based Physical Therapy in Parkinson's Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper helps dive into the world of audio signal processing deeper by using MATLAB to convert a given input music signal into legible music notes that could, not only be used in a variety of fields. A core example of the usage of music can be observed in the treatment of patients with Parkinson’s Disease (PD). Based off several studies, the provision of audio support helps us observe the effects of musical-based therapy on an array of areas ranging from classification of functioning, disability and health components such as cognition, balance and functional mobility. Another application of this research comes in the field of music where the cognition of specific notes could help with the identification of songs and writing of sheet music just by identifying the notes.

articleTitle: COVID-19 SOP Compliance And Monitoring Electronic System For Business And Public Places Using Arduino Uno
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: COVID-19 Corona virus disease is a rapidly spreading contagious disease that is causing a global public health crisis. In December 2019, the coronavirus was identified in Wuhan, China. COVID-19 is causing severe disease issues and many people are losing their lives daily. SARS-CoV-2 (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome coronavirus 2) is a severe infectious disease that is spreading very fast and is currently inflicting a healthcare crisis across the globe. The lethal coronavirus was founded in Wuhan, China in December 2019. The symptoms of this disease are fever, cough, fatigue, no taste or smell, stinging throat, headache, and difficulty in breathing. This deadly disease, COVID-19, is difficult to identify and spread. The vaccination process is still going on around the world. There are some existing strategies to minimize the spread of the COVID-19 virus by monitoring the temperature rise using sensors, wearing masks, and sanitizing their hands frequently. The proposed system comprises of an RFID reader, an IR sensor, a temperature sensor, a buzzer, a laptop or a personal computer with a web cam. A person on entry gets detected for their body temperature, wearing a face mask and then sanitizing their hands. If the temperature of the person is below 37.6 degrees, i.e., below the acceptance limit, then mask detection takes place by using MATLAB followed by spraying the sanitizer. Now the door will open automatically. Otherwise, the door will not open and the buzzer will sound. With these precautionary steps, people can survive this pandemic situation.

articleTitle: Interior Angle Computation for detecting Adversary Sensor in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: After being distributed over a wireless sensor network (WSN), the sensor nodes in the network normally remain in the same place permanently. An attacker who compromises a subset of the nodes is not essential to stand by the same restriction. This article introduces Interior Angle Computation for detecting adversary sensor (IACD) in WSN. The main awareness of this scheme for applying the angle-based method is to decide the adversary node. In this case, the sender wishes to transmit the information to the receiver, and the sender selects the neighbor node that will serve as the next hop in the network. The subsequent hop chooses, from among the neighbors of the sender node, the sensor node that is geographically closest to the recipient. The sender selected the neighboring node, and the sensor node that was physically closest to it created the triangle. In this triangle, the three inner angles add up to a total of 180 degrees, and in order to achieve a value of 180 degrees for the triangle, each of these three nodes must be a genuine sensor node. If it is not, then the node is an opponent. In addition, this approach applies a binary tree algorithm to improve the routing efficiency. It improves routing efficiency. The simulation results explain that the IACD has a better packet rate and increases the remaining energy in the network. In addition, it increases the adversary detection ratio in the WSN.

articleTitle: Robotic Process Automation (RPA): A software bot for healthcare sector
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Nowadays different corporate sectors in the world want all digital works done by human to be automated and done very quickly. Here comes Robotic Process Automation (RPA) technology which helps in building software robots called digital bots which mimics and integrates works of human that he does sitting with digital system. So in the current paper we are presenting tasks performed in health care division using software bots. One use case is claiming insurance, here our software robot will open web form, bot fills all needed insurance details collected and stored in electronic media (excel sheet) already, submitting the form once data entry done, repeat the same task for another patient. Second use case is collecting day-wise critical patient information which are received through chat-bots and processing patients details which are found critical. Work finishes within fractions of seconds without human intervention.

articleTitle: Design of Novel Coupled FED MIMO Antennas for Future Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The next-generation 5G smartphone is provided with a small broadband and dual band antenna for building the multiple input multiple output (MIMO) array. Antennas that are used before are capable of working in the particular frequency applications where quarter wave length radiators are subjected to miniaturization which offers to form limited bandwidth and low radiation efficiency. Less reception due to high return loss due to single patch antenna are used for each individual device. The most common radiator can be modified using the current techniques found in the open literature by bending, folding, meandering, and wrapping. Depending on the application, each method has a different set of benefits. When a finite antenna ground plane is introduced, it is frequently extended to include reconfigurable features. As a result, small, multiband antennas like these are frequently strong candidates for use in a variety of wireless applications. It is planned to work on a slotted multiband planar system for frequency bands such as IN GPS(1.575-1.665GHz), WLAN (2.4-2.545GHz), and WiMAX(3.27-3.97GHz). we proposed a design of a single antenna to cover more than 3 frequency band applications (multiband antenna) which can be used for existing wireless services. The miniaturization is done by having a two T shaped stub and a single U shaped stub to achieve the minimal return loss for the four spectrum. In spite of the extremely low ground clearances, the simulated results show good impedance matching, isolation, gain, directivity, and antenna efficiency performance.

articleTitle: Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Inverter with a High-Gain Reboost Luo Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This project proposes a single-phase, three-level voltage source inverter for use with a PV system that is based on the Reboost Luo converter. By way of a Reboost LUO converter, the solar system supplies the inverter with the necessary voltage. In order to harvest the maximum amount of electricity from the PV system, the MPPT fuzzy logic method is utilised. Because it makes use of a renewable energy source to generate electricity, the solar photovoltaic (PV) energy generation system has been examined as a leading contender for the title of most prominent energy system by power producers all over the world. However, in order to increase total production, a grid-connected PV system with a DC-DC reboostluo converter has been implemented. This converter increases the low level DC voltage produced by the PV panel to a level that is equivalent to the voltage produced by the grid. By utilising a closed loop control method in conjunction with a PI controller, it is feasible to guarantee the operation of the controller and increase the amount of power that can be extracted from the PV panel. A PI controller is assigned to a voltage source inverter (VSI), which removes steady-state error and assists in obtaining the desired grid voltage by analogizing the real power with the reference power. The achieved voltage is then delivered into the grid through the VSI. The direct current (DC) voltage is changed into alternating current (AC) voltage by using this single-phase voltage source inverter. Simulation in Matlab is used to carry out the work for this project.

articleTitle: Model Based Design Accelerometer Control system in EV-ECU For HIL Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)

articleTitle: Towards Smart Data Mining Support Based on Annotation Beneficial Grouping Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A data mining (DM) system requires many steps, such as pre-processing the data, execution of the data mining algorithm, and extracting mining results. They can be a straightforward but traditional procedure. Each step has multiple choices; only a few variations provide promising results. Both beginners and specialists in data mining require assistance with the vast reach and non-trivial experiences throughout the composition and collection of DM methods. The intelligent exploration assistant prototype enables customers who have access to a systemic list of valid DM processes to raise the ranks of these valid processes in accordance with a variety of criteria. This helps customer's select DM processes that are appropriate and may be more efficient than other options, and it also ensures that appropriate alternatives are not overlooked. The prototypes demonstrate that a single IDA is still capable of having relevant lists and performing successful classification even in basic classification procedures. The potential for an IDA to play a significant role as a medium for the exchange of information within a data mining community is investigated. In conclusion, it has been shown that the claims have been proved by demonstrating that cost-sensitive classes have used a more nuanced procedure utilizing information gained from the KDDCUP competition in 1998.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Solar Energy Generation and Radiation Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Solar photo voltaic (PV) energy system backbone of the renewable energy system. Energy system is depended on weather conditions such as temperature and radiation intensity. The role of machine learning (ML) for solar energy generation and radiation forecasting. This paper presents ML algorithm or methods review for prediction of solar energy generation and radiation. This paper also presents the state of art on different ML methods and parameters for forecasting solar energy production and radiation.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Analysis Using Hybrid Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Heart sickness is one of the maximum extreme demanding situations that the arena is going through today. In the sector of medical facts analysis, predicting cardiovascular sickness is a main difficulty. Machine learning (ML) has proven to be beneficial in producing alternatives and forecasts primarily based totally on good sized quantities of facts. This paper provides a method for predicting if someone has coronary heart sickness and offering records or a diagnostic to the affected person approximately the risk. The prediction version is constructed the use of a mixture of various alternatives and loads of extra categorization approaches. This is finished via way of means of evaluating the accuracy of numerous algorithms in opposition to the outputs of hybrid system version separately, after which selecting the technique with the great accuracy for prediction. Our goal is to enhance the model's overall performance via way of means of deleting beside the point and unneeded functions from the dataset and handiest gathering those which might be maximum informative and useful for the classification. The key aim of this paper is to appoint data analytics to forecast whether or not or now no longer the contamination is present.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Dielectric Modulated Dual Material Double Gate Hetero Stack (DM-DMDG-HS) TFET
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This paper presents a detailed sensitivity analysis of dielectric modulated (DM) hetero stack (HS) source based dual material double gate (DMDG) TFET biosensor through Sentaurus TCAD simulator. Here, four cavities are introduced near the source and drain regions for both the gate material through etching of Hf02 dielectric material and thus, a large number of biomolecules can be accommodate. Sensitivity (Sn) analysis is highlighted for both neutral and charged (positive/negative) biomolecules when cavity is entirely filled with biomolecules with dielectric constant (k) equivalent to various proteins. The obtained sensitivity is in the order of 10<sup>4</sup> implies the viability of the proposed sensor. We have reported the subthreshold swing (SS), transfer characteristics, and I<inf>ON</inf>/I<inf>OFF</inf> ratio of the biosensor for various proteins. Furthermore, steric hindrance gives better understanding in terms of non-ideal state of this sensor and decreasing profile has highest sensitivity at different fill factor (FF).

articleTitle: Design and Development of PV Based Hybrid Multilevel Inverter with Ziegler-Nichols Tunning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Looking towards the current circumstances in the industry multilevel inverter rise in popularity for the high voltage and medium voltage application also in the sustainable energy fields. The multilevel inverter is used for the dc-ac conversion, this paper presents a design and simulation of hybrid multilevel inverter which is the combination of Diode clamped multi-level inverter and cascaded H-bridge inverter for the AC conversion and for the DC voltage source a PV based boost converter is used and study of PI controller tuning methods on a DC-DC Boost converter modeled using Ziegler-Nichols's frequency domain method. A simulation study using MATLAB& SIMULINK tool is carried out in this work. Involves the mathematical relation between the input and output and the state variable. Looking towards the changes and to reduce the error a PI controller is implemented to study the behavior of the complete system.

articleTitle: Virtual User Interface for Differently Abled People Using Vision Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: We are aware that using computers has become commonplace. But using digital devices like laptops, pcs and tablets is too challenging for those with varied abilities (those without hands and those who are paralyzed). Our goal is to use a webcam to read real-time video while integrating various face emotions with the corresponding mouse events. In order to imitate mouse motions and order, we used pyautoGUI in conjunction with OpenCV for image processing and computer vision tasks. Image processing is mainly used to identify faces and facial expressions. For key board related functions, we integrated speech to text conversion. Speech is transformed to text whenever user speaks and it will be displayed according to the user's wish like when the cursor is over a search box or a micro soft word. By doing this, all the computer tasks can be accomplished without the usage of hands.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Network for Vision-Based UAV Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) could be used carelessly or intentionally, which poses a serious risk to aviation safety. This makes automated UAV detection and tracking a crucial component of aerial security systems. Radar, radio frequency, and visible- and thermal-infrared imaging are often used technologies for UAV detection. Deep neural networks (DNNs) for the image-based object recognition have recently made advancements that make it possible to leverage For this detecting and tracking challenge, visual data. Through the encoder-decoder structure network, the suggested technique first estimates the distribution line area. The interference is eliminated using sampling clustering and image processing operations. Finally, based on the discovered distribution line, the UAV direction of tracking of the power line is determined. The approach can achieve a frame inspection speed of over 78 ms, a heading error of deviation range of (−1.53°, 1.36°), and a tracking rate of almost 99%. The results of the network and inspection technique dataset test demonstrate that the approach presented in this research may be used to check UAV distribution lines efficiently, swiftly, and accurately.

articleTitle: Cassava Disease Classification with Knowledge Distillation for use in Constrained Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In this paper, we present a method for improving the performance of a deep learning model for cassava leaf disease classification on constrained devices using knowledge distillation (KD). KD involves transferring knowledge from a deeper teacher model to a shallow student network, enabling us to reduce the weight of the model without sacrificing its performance. Our proposed approach is aimed at creating a cost-effective and mobile-optimized solution for cassava leaf disease classification, which is of particular importance given the high carbohydrate content and susceptibility to viral infections of cassava. Through the incorporation of KD, we demonstrate the potential for our method to enhance the performance of deep learning models in resource-constrained environments.

articleTitle: A Robust Model for the Identification of Bolt Loosening in Steel Structures Based on Modified Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: When a bolt becomes free owing to stress, pressure, or bending stresses, this is called spontaneous releasing. A fastened joint may lose all of its preload with even a little amount of spin. That's the number one reason fasteners go loose. Preventing bridge collapse is often possible if missing bolts and nuts are identified before they are used. The focus of this study is on applying deep learning methods to create a new architecture for the early identification of bolt-nut losses in steel structures. The goals are to use deep learning methods to create a methodology for detecting nuts, bolts, and nut slots; to implement that strategy in Python; and to evaluate the effectiveness of that architecture. An 8x8 grid of bridge photos was used as input for CNN-LSTM methods. The CNN's unusually high recognition rate may be explained by the sequential nature of its extraction through convolution and pooling. Nevertheless, statistical analysis of the data indicated that there was no statistically significant distinction in object identification and classification performance among the methods used in the final design. The CNN model is recommended for spotting nuts, bolts, and nut holes on structural steel bridges because to its excellent detection rate, high accuracy, and fast throughput.

articleTitle: Vehicle Braking System using MSP430 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The population of vehicles is growing at a faster rate as per advancement and improvement of the living standard of human beings. Road accidents become a major concern in every country with the growth of vehicles. The main reason for road accidents could be the timing of brakes applied while riding. For this automobile, industries are constantly struggling to develop self-governing brake systems to minimize the accidents on road. The design of the brake system is the most critical part of a vehicle in current safety technology to avoid road accidents. The braking system can be designed to prevent the possibility of collision with the sensor technology. In this paper to overcome this issue, a vehicle braking system is designed using an IR sensor and MSP 430 microcontroller. This braking system takes suitable action and save the vehicle from accident if any obstacle comes in front of the vehicle in its appropriate range. It will turn on the alarm and show the emergency message on display

articleTitle: Nonlinear Prediction of Speech Signal using Short Term Forecasting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: This research paper presents nonlinear prediction of speech signal using forecasting algorithm. Here both clean and noisy speech samples are predicted using the nearest neighbors of the sample to be predicted. We also discuss the optimum number of nearest neighbors required to obtain the best results. Various parameters like embedding dimension, delay and number of nearest neighbors were varied to analyze the optimal parameter set for a chaotic predictor for speech signals. It was observed that dimensionality of speech varies between 6 and 10 and the prediction error was reducing with the increase of number of nearest neighbors.

articleTitle: Power Spectral Density Analysis of Decomposed EMG Signals for Dominant and Non-dominant Hands
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Electromyography (EMG) computes the electrical activity of the muscles. While performing certain work, groups of muscles are incorporated. As the muscle force required to perform that particular work increases, the central nervous system triggering signal increases in terms of activation of more motor units under that particular muscle. This results in high EMG signal amplitudes. EMG signal varies even when the same work is performed by both hands i.e., dominating and non-dominating hands. This led us to evaluate EMG Power Spectral Density (PSD) while performing passive muscle movement and active muscle movement, carrying different weights. EMG was recorded at the biceps brachii and analyzed for 7–10 healthy subjects. Subjects were requested to perform the concentric contraction of both dominating and non-dominating hand muscles while lifting 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 kgs of the weight. The result shows significant EMG PSD variations during the contraction of hand muscles. These findings could be applied to the patient's muscle movement to develop a verification of the presence of muscle activity in the patients for both hands.

articleTitle: Spoken Dialog Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The basic idea is to make the system recognize human speech and in turn respond in the form of speech. The aim is to build an android application based ticket booking through which people can interact with the system directly through speech. Spoken Dialog Systems (SDS) are speech based interfaces for Human Computer Interaction (HCI). There are systems which responds in the form of text when the user talks and there are also some systems which responds in the form of voice when user gives the input in the form of text. There are systems which are called Interactive Voice Response (IVR) which operates following set of commands. Our project aims at developing a system that eliminates the drawback of existing systems. So, hereby we are going to develop a model which makes the user and system to get interacted without following a set of commands and thereby getting interacted in a natural language. The existing systems have a disadvantage where the user has to remember all the instructions, commands and keywords that are inbuilt in it to carry a specific task. These systems are not user friendly for illiterates and physically challenged. Therefore, to overcome all these hurdles we are going to propose a model to book a ticket.

articleTitle: Smart Mining Helmet with Body Vitals and Location Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Across the world, the mining industry is one of the most prominent industries and directly affects the host country's GDP. Despite this, sufficient steps are not taken to protect the workers in most cases. Coming from low-income families, they do not know their rights, and companies exploit the same. A helmet is an essential element of a miner's uniform as it protects the wearer's head in a dangerous environment as mines are not always secure and workers can get injured. Using the internet of things, we can integrate various sensors with the helmet to keep a tab on the miner's vitals and external environmental conditions. Additionally, we have also proposed a solution to keep track of the wearer's location throughout the mine to ensure immediate assistance if any disaster occurs.

articleTitle: Automated Awning System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The on-going era is life dependent on technology. A design for protection of clothes and crops using Arduino UNO with rain water sensor. The sensors will detect the rainwater intensity and transmit the information to the microcontroller, which allows the microcontroller to make a decision and turn on the awning mechanism. The uses of an Arduino microcontroller is to provide a suitable platform for implementing an embedded control system and is possible to modify it to meet the future requirements easily and quickly. One never knows when it is going to rain. The unpredictability of rains is an underrated issue. An unpredictable shower can cause clothes drying outside to get wet and dirty. This may in turn cause an increase in use of water to wash the clothes again. While the focus of this work is primarily on this domestic issue, the scope of the work can be extended to protect crops from random showers that might otherwise prove to be a huge loss to farmers. While we see technology being used to change the way the world functions, certain domestic works continue to be untouched by automation. This work would like to bring technology to every household and save our mothers that extra worry with regards to the clothes drying on their terraces.

articleTitle: A Novel Characterization of the Fake News in Twitter Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Nowadays, mobile usage is widely expanding with the help of the internet. This statement also spreads fake news easily and negatively impacts society. As a result, it's critical to create a basic mathematical model to comprehend fake news on social networks. To address this, it develops the auto-regressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) and the long-term short memory (LSTM) to detect false news more accurately to maintain high-level security in social networks. The proposed novel deep learning model accurately identifies fake news based on standard historical data. The performance of this model is validated with three standard metrics: accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and F1-Score. The proposed LSTM predictor achieved nearly 97.5% accuracy, 94.6% the F1-score, and 91.2<sup>%</sup> sensitivity on average. The results are compared with other existing methodologies, and the proposed framework outperformed existing methodologies. This framework provides promising solutions to detect and predict fake news.

articleTitle: The Role of Machine Learning Analysis and Metrics in Retailing Industry by using Progressive Analysis Pattern Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Analyzing customer purchasing data has been a challenging task for data analyzers. Even though lots of methods are introduced in this kind of research but still many barriers are there to finding the optimal pattern. Consider customer buying data is used to examine the types of parameters which is influence the customer. In this proposed work, Progressive Analysis Pattern Technique (PAPT) to predict future customer buying patterns in online shopping. We incorporated dynamic data handling prior to the proposed methodology. It will give ample purpose for the organization's perspective because the proposed work primarily focused on customer features related to the number of product quantities and product price variations of the previous purchase. Marketing strategies are most effective if they are focused to the exact client requirements. A Significant mission in campaign planning is deciding which customer to target. This research paper focusses on empirical targeting models.

articleTitle: Classification of potato diseases using deep learning apprach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Non-destructive and rapid inspection utilising deep learning and image processing may be of tremendous use for potatoes and other agricultural products. In this study, we recommend employing a deep neural network to separate diseased potatoes into groups according to their outer appearance. Train, test, and evaluate the resulting DNN using a collection of potato pictures. Using Machine Learning, a Modified Support Vector Machine (MSVM) and a Conv. Neural Network (CNN) were used to make predictions and comparisons about the segmentation and feature extraction of a potato picture. Canada and the United States Department of Agriculture standard datasets were modified for the purpose of testing the suggested model. The results show that deep learning is superior to both traditional methods and the Machine learning model. In some sort of picture, more than 99 % accuracy recorded, while in others, approach 97 percent.

articleTitle: A Knowledge based Approach for User Profiling from the Multilingual Texts in the Social Media Platforms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: In the online platforms, people prefer to write their views in their own language in different creative ways which is a big challenge in the sentiment analysis task. In this report, an algorithm is proposed for sentiment analysis for the multilingual texts posted by the users in different online platforms. The goal of this work is to identify the sentiment behind the message of the user as well as the topic on which h(sh)e is commenting. The overall work has been carried out in three phases. In the first phase, the multilingual texts have been converted into a uniform language using the UNICODE range; second, the sense of the message has been derived based on a training data set; and third, the topic of the message is identified with the help of a newspaper archive and WordNet. The data sets are prepared from various social media and E-commerce platforms. The proposed model is tested on 10 different languages such as English, Bengali, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Gujrati, Punjabi, Malayalam, Urdu, and Kannada. The challenges and the pitfalls of this work are explained in detail at the end of this report.

articleTitle: A Novel Asymmetric 21-Level Inverter with PV System fed to Motor Load
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Due to their low cost, wide availability, and lack of maintenance requirements, renewable energy sources (RES) have been favoured in this work to effectively meet the load demand. This is because, in the present scenario, RES play a remarkably important role in the process of improving the function of motor load. When compared to now, the importance of RE Sources in enhancing motor load function was much lower in the past. This effort relies heavily on the Sepic converter, since its goal is to enhance the system's performance as a whole. However, the ANFIS method greatly facilitates the process of achieving the Maximum PowerPoint Tracking (MPPT). The purpose of this effort is to increase the voltage range across which PVs may operate at full efficiency. The Multi Level Inverter (MLI) is set up in the best possible way, which increases the system's dependability to its highest possible level with little effort. A 21 Level (31L) inverter does an impressive job of balancing out fluctuations in load demand. The whole of the system is simulated by using MATLAB Simulink, and the results that were obtained demonstrated that the strategy that was presented provides ideal performance since it reduces the amount of Total Harmonic Distortions (THD) to a higher degree.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Data Mining Process in Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Protecting the privacy of users in web-scale data mining applications and systems like online searching, recommender systems, crowd-sourced platforms, and analytics apps has developed into an incredibly essential component in recent years. This is especially true in light of recent data breaches and new legislation such as GDPR. In this tutorial, we'll go over a history of privacy violations from the last two decades, along with the lessons we gained from them, as well as important rules and legislation and how privacy tactics have evolved into different privacy definitions and techniques. Data mining raises unique privacy risks, despite being successful in many applications. The literature has looked at the trade-offs that the current system presents between utility and personal privacy. However, industrial deployment has its own unique challenges when it comes to the management of resource trade-offs between computation and communication. The industrial deployments that are taking place right now are rather scattered. Each device (such a mobile phone, for example) is responsible for storing a single data point, and it is the server's job to compute aggregates based on the data that is obtained from the distinct mix of public and private information that is associated with each device. In spite of the fact that computing on servers is quite inexpensive, computing on clients is somewhat pricey since clients are often comprised of low-power devices. The expectation maximization (EM) technique for distribution reconstruction is discussed in this study. It is superior to the existing approach regarding the degree of information loss. The percentage of information loss is only 4%. In particular, we show that the EM approach, when applied to data that has been subjected to a perturbation, eventually arrives at the maximum likelihood estimate of the distribution that was being modeled. We demonstrate that the EM algorithm produces reliable estimations of the original distribution when considerable data is available.

articleTitle: Detection Of Snowball and Jersey Colour And Jersey Number Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: A snowball is spherical item composed of snow that is often formed by scooping snow into the hands and compacting it into a ball. Games like snowball battles frequently involve the use of snowballs. A larger snowball can also be created by rolling a smaller snowball across a snowy surface. As it rolls, the smaller snowball gathers more snow, which causes it to grow. Tracking separate performers on ice as well as team strategic decision-making depend on the ability of coaches and other analysts to accurately identify snowball performers and squads in a game. In contrast, snowball is a fluid sport because of the complicated situations and frequent team substitutions, which cause the players to adopt different postures while playing. In this proposed system, individual ice snowball players are distinguished using a 2-phase cascaded convolution neural network (CNN) prototypical, jersey color of discovered individuals is recovered to additional ascertain team connections. Because we used a dataset we created from real images, our algorithm is able to remove most of disturbing details, which results in an overall detection accuracy as well as recall amount of over 95% for separate performers, an average detection accuracy of over 96% for teams. With our own dataset, we are able to reach maximum degree of accuracy in our player detection algorithm.

articleTitle: Energy Proficient and Dependable Cluster Routing in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Huge energy utilization information of structures is created with the improving information technology. The energy utilization information is processed by an energy depletion observing system through the wireless sensor network (WSN). Conventional security approaches can face external attacks. Nevertheless, they cannot proficiently solve interior attacks triggered by the captured nodes. Energy-efficient and Dependable Cluster Routing (EPDC) in WSN. This approach aims to reduce energy expenditure and enhance reliable routing in WSNs. The highest energy and highest available bandwidth are selected as a cluster head (CH). In every cluster, the selected CH has received the observed information from the cluster member and then forwarded it to the BS through a relay node. The forwarder relay node is selected based on the average energy faith and transmission faith during data transmission. The whole faith is greater than the average value that node is selected as a data forwarder from cluster to BS in the WSN. Furthermore, the Path Optimization Algorithm (POA) is used to detect the obstacle and build the obstacle-aware route efficiently. The simulation results explain why the proposed method has better residual energy. In addition, it minimized both the network delay and the packet loss rate in the WSN.

articleTitle: Planar Thin Film Resistor Based Wilkinson Power Divider Realization & Its Characterization at S-band
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Wilkinson Power Dividers (WPD) are fabricated with thin film resistor having standard and broadband topologies at S-band. Sputtered chromium layer is utilized to achieve desired resistance. Generally, WPD are implemented with discrete resistor which results in various undesired parasitics at microwave frequencies along with thermal variations which poses constraint in meeting system performance. Pad size, spacing for discrete resistor mounting also to be considered to avoid performance degradation. Further, the chip resistor at higher frequencies are not easily available and having considerable reactance. The presented article simple realization technique of using sputtered metallized layer of thin film technology along with broad banding technique. Test results and comparative analysis are tabulated at S-band along with thermal variations.

articleTitle: Designing Rectangular Patch Antennafor broad band 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Patch antenna consists of a plated geometry as patch on one side of the PCB and the other side with a ground plane. Nowadays, internet of things and 5G technologies enters into numerous fields to transmit massive data. This antenna is used in many portable devices. The proposed work designs arectangular microstrip antenna using High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) simulationsoftware. The antenna is designed for 7.5 GHz resonant frequency. For the frequency range between 5GHzto 10 GHz the reflection coefficient is observed as - 10dB. The proposed patch antenna is selected with Rogers RT/duroid 5880[tm]. Also, the design includes loss tangent of 0.02 with dielectric constant (cr = 2.2). Then the configured rectangular patch is activatedwith reasonable length and width transmission lines. Internet of Things (IOT) devices with GPS capabilities can use Patch antenna for satellite transmission. Also, this antenna finds applicationin WLAN, WIFI, etc.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach based on Supervised and Unsupervised ML algorithms for Efficient Design of Demand Response Programs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Demand Response (DR) programs provide high potential incentive-based management solution for targeting Demand Side Management (DSM) objectives such as reducing system's peak demand. The incentives can be designed in an effective manner, by leveraging the smart meter consumption data to analyze customer's load pattern variation for a defined duration and find potential target periods and customer groups to incentivize. Clustering and load profiling is a well-known methodology in DR program design. Algorithm selection, is however based on compactness of clusters. This paper proposes a methodology to select Clustering algorithm based on the set objective. In addition, the approach- based on data stratification, supervised and unsupervised Machine Learning (ML) techniques, serves to find key potential target time periods, customer groups, and decision threshold points (in kWh) for incentive-design, in efficient, direct, customer-friendly and objective-oriented manner, which can be incorporated to plan strategic incentive-based DR programs.

articleTitle: Inferring User Image-Search Goals Using SVM and Re-ranking process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Inferring user image search primarily creates pure images from search engine results. The current image-searched re-ranking algorithms needed to be more reliable because of the assumption that the first text-oriented image-search result is used in the re-ranking technique. The visualized re-ranking method had been intended to refine the search results from the text-oriented picture program by incorporating the knowledge supplied by the imagined sense to increase the precision of the search ranking. Visualized re-ranking has become a favorite research topic in the multimedia retrieving and laptop vision sectors since it allows for the consideration of visualized sense in previous picture search engines in a lightweight manner without causing acquisition measurability issues. Furthermore, visual re-ranking may be utilised to increase the quality of the acquired information in the technique of mechanically creating online coaching information for object identification, in addition to the picture search situation using SVM classification for the different image datasets. The study of a question's user search aims will be extremely useful in improving computer program connection and user experience, i.e., 91% accuracy. Although much focus has been on inferring user objectives or intents for text searches, more must be predicted for image searches.

articleTitle: Arduino Uno Based Swarm Intelligence Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Swarm robotics is an emerging study area in which swarm intelligence is applied to multi-robot systems. It investigates ways to employ local rules to coordinate massive groups of relatively simple robots. Its study involves the design of a series of highly simple robots, as well as their physical form and working control. Numerous successful experiments have been carried out and researchers are investigating to improve the working swarm robots. Swarm robotics is based on the creation, deployment, and coordination of large groups of robots to solve a problem or execute a task. The distinctive characteristics of intelligent systems are described in relation to single bots and other number of co-systems after a brief discussion of the nature of swarms and swarm intelligence. Following that, a list of various frequently used swarm robotics entity is shown in various swarm robotics modeling approach. By presenting present scenarios that cannot be resolved by a single bot or a small number of robots operated in a typical, centralized manner, the most feasible industries for swarm implementations and evaluate its potential influence on particular industries. The paper represents on swarm robotic approaches, which includes cooperative control mechanisms in intelligent systems for swarming, navigating, and searching tasks.

articleTitle: Identification of Key Genes Involved in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome in Obese Patients: A Bioinformatics Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Women of reproductive age are commonly affected with Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), a heterogeneous disorder. PCOS is associated chiefly with polycystic ovaries, hirsutism, and ovulation failure. Impact of obesity on phenotype of PCOS and reproductive functions has both genetic and environmental influences. Recently, many different research strategies deciphered the molecular mechanisms of PCOS, which includes in silico approaches also, such as high throughput RNA sequencing. Therefore, to find the Differential gene expression (DEGs), we will be using secondary clinical data of microarray datasets for clinical studies of PCOS patients. Our study showed vigorous gene signatures in obese PCOS conditions. It elucidates that the dysregulations of these genes were connected with the development and progression of obesity followed by PCOS. Furthermore, up-regulated genes FRZB, MYH1, RBM3, NMRK2, NANOS1, and IRX3 and down-regulated genes LDHB, LPL, SLC38Al, and MAFF as the hub genes might has important in the diagnosis and treatment for obesity-induced PCOS.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Application in Detecting Wrinkle and Predicting Age
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: One of the natural process that happens in human body is aging, estimating age is one of the challenging task as it includes variety of factors like gender, lifestyle, workplace and mental health. The basic objective of this work is to recognize the human face using suitable face recognition technique, abstract the features of recognized face using appropriate feature extraction method. Although there are numerous applications for predicting age based on face photos and other skin-related elements, we propose a suitable and accurate method which detects wrinkles and predicts age by comparing and analyzing the various advanced technologies present.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 32-Bit MIPS RISC Processor with Flexible 5-Stage Pipelining and Dynamic Thermal Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: The main aim of this design is design a 5-stage flexible pipelined 32-bit RISC-V processor using system Verilog including it Dynamic thermal management technique. This Design is be based on MIPS instruction set architecture(ISA) in which stages of pipeline include Instruction fetch, Instruction Decode, Execute, Memory access, Write back. The RISC[Reduced Instruction set Computed] compared to CISC[Complex instruction set computer] executes instruction in one clock and instructions are always uniformly lengthen and fixed instruction format based opcode. Hence RISC is preferable more used for less complex tasks and low power designs. Based on the literature the proposed design brings significant improvements in simulation speeds due to flexible pipeline technique and low power consumption is achieved. The Primary desire of this paper is to simulate and synthesize the design by perform basic ALU operations and provide desired outputs.

articleTitle: Image Recognition and Enhancement Using Multi-Scale Retinex and Histogram Equalization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Intelligent and Innovative Technologies in Computing, Electrical and Electronics (IITCEE)
abstract: Nowadays, the need for a safe and at ease device is favoured by using every character in society. A fee-effective system is needed for Aerial surveillance systems capable of enhancing situational focus in the course of a couple of scales of place and time. With the assistance of an aerial surveillance machine, we are capable of accumulating a device that could report unmanned vehicles and humans.
